title: NOAA Weather Observation Record
description: Schema for NOAA weather station observation data including surface, aviation, and cooperative network reports

observation_id.description: Unique identifier for the observation record

station_id.description: NOAA weather station identifier (ICAO, WBAN, or COOP ID)

station_name.description: Human-readable name of the weather station

timestamp.description: Date and time of the observation in UTC

latitude.description: Latitude of the weather station in decimal degrees

longitude.description: Longitude of the weather station in decimal degrees

elevation_m.description: Elevation of the weather station in meters above sea level

value.description: The observed measurement value in the specified unit

unit.description: Unit of measure for the observed value

quality_flag.description: Quality control flag indicating data reliability

data_source.description: Observing network or reporting format that produced this record

report_type.description: Sub-type or category of the weather report (e.g., routine, special, corrections)

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded into the data platform

_ingested_at.description: Timestamp when the record was ingested by the pipeline

_source.description: Source system or API endpoint that provided the record

_batch_id.description: Batch identifier for the ingestion run that produced this record
